t: What is the latest Black Friday boycott – and will it work? | Black Friday | The Guardian
s: December 2, 2025 - Home Depot is one of the businesses targeted by the We Ain’t Buying It campaign. Photograph: Matt Kelley/AP ... While others scramble for deals on Black Friday and Cyber Monday, activists hope to leverage shopping behavior for societal change · People in the US: Have you gotten involved in activism or community organizing this year? ... Building on the momentum of consumer boycotts against Target and other companies earlier this year, grassroots organizers want American consumers to use their economic power this Thanksgiving weekend to protest the Trump administration’s anti-immigration and anti-DEI crackdowns – and the big corporations that won’t oppose them.
